rows.corpus_definition: To say something again using different words to make it clearer.
rows.example_en: Please paraphrase the main idea of that long paragraph.

rows.corpus_definition: To forgive someone for a mistake or a bad action.
rows.example_en: The king decided to pardon the prisoner.

rows.corpus_definition: A very small piece of matter.
rows.example_en: A dust particle flew into my eye.

rows.corpus_definition: To die, usually in a violent or sudden way.
rows.example_en: Many animals perish in the harsh winter cold.

rows.corpus_definition: To treat someone cruelly because of their beliefs or race.
rows.example_en: Many people fled the country to avoid being persecuted.

rows.corpus_definition: To have salty liquid come through your skin when hot.
rows.example_en: I always perspire during a hard workout.

rows.corpus_definition: Thinking that bad things will happen.
rows.example_en: Do not be so pessimistic about the future.

rows.corpus_definition: A chemical used to kill insects that damage crops.
rows.example_en: Farmers use pesticide to save their harvest.

rows.corpus_definition: a ghost or spirit that appears but is not real
rows.example_en: Villagers believed a phantom haunted the old abandoned house.

rows.corpus_definition: Something that happens in the world which can be seen.
